description: Calculate the corrected band gap of the CdS wurtzite (100) prismatic surface. PBE severely underestimates the gap.
user_prompt: Calculate the band gap of the CdS (100) surface (wurtzite structure, P6_3mc) and report its value in eV.

references: Giacopetti, Nevin, Comelli, Valentini, Nardelli & Satta, AIP Adv. 8, 065202 (2018)
Satta, CNR Short-Term Mobility Programme Report 2017-2052 (2017)
method.modeling: Use the clean nonpolar wurtzite CdS (100) prismatic surface. Build a slab thick enough to recover a bulk-like interior and include at least 15 A vacuum.
method.rationale: The scored value is the ACBN0 clean-surface CdS gap reported for the CdS surface, while the recommended VASP protocol uses the same empirical Cd 4d and S 3p +U values as the bulk CdS case. Plain PBE/GGA gives a much smaller CdS gap near 1.1-1.2 eV and is not the benchmark target here. The wider tolerance covers ACBN0 versus fixed Dudarev PBE+U differences and residual slab-thickness/surface-relaxation sensitivity.
